instruction.text: Vervollständige die Regeln, indem du das jeweils passende Satzende auswählst.

atoms.sound: Nicht-notwendige Relativsätze sind für das Verständnis des Hauptsatzes nicht notwendig.
Nicht-notwendige Relativsätze werden mit Kommas vom Hauptsatz abgetrennt.

atoms.a: I really liked Adam, who just came by.
I am going to visit my grandparents, whose dog I miss a lot.
My sister, whose friend has pink hair, wants a new hairstyle.

instruction.text: Schreibe die passenden Relativpronomen in die Lücken.

atoms.b: Jake, ((who)) has a dog, two cats and a bird, plays basketball.
My friend, ((whose)) mother is a musical singer, will take me to one of her shows.
My brother went to the clothes shop just around the corner, ((which)) newly opened.
His aunt, ((who)) lives in Scotland, visited them yesterday.
My parents tried to pack the car, ((which)) did not have enough space for all the luggage.
